entries.summary:
Phase 1 drift verification PASSED. All FR and SC requirements verified in source code:

FR-001: WebSocket server at server.py with asyncio+websockets ✓
FR-002: Two-player game flow with async WebSocket messaging ✓
FR-003: Top-out detection (is_top_out → game_over) + rematch (rematch_votes, reset_room) ✓
FR-004: 7 tetrominoes, SRS rotations with wall kicks, hold_piece, hard_drop, next_piece ✓
FR-005: Room class with add/remove/join, cleanup_empty_rooms, full-room rejection ✓
FR-006: 4-char room codes (A-Z+0-9), ready state, opponent discovery ✓
FR-008: broadcast after lock/move, 50ms sleep loop for 20Hz sync ✓
SC-001: 100/300/500/800 × level scoring in clear_lines ✓
SC-002: 7-bag randomizer in new_piece (self.bag) ✓
SC-003: get_attack_lines (0/1/2/4), set_garbage_queue ✓
SC-004: heartbeat_loop (5s check, 2-miss disconnect) ✓

Minor naming variance: RoomManager.get_room() instead of get_room_by_player(), cleanup_empty_rooms() instead of remove_empty_rooms() — functional equivalent.
